note: Forbidden: an LS Request for an LSA absent from the database not generating BadLSReq. Red: TestOSPFBadLSReqRestart fails on HandleLSReq != reasonBadLSReq, on state != exstart, and on the resent DD not being the initial I|M|MS DD. Other polarity: TestOSPFValidLSReqSendsLSUpdate and TestRFC2328KnownLSRequestDoesNotRestartExchange go red if a satisfiable request restarts the exchange (state change, exstart) or is not answered with one LS Update carrying that LSA. One clause, both polarities.
